title: Enchantment
content:
Type: ENCH
Papyrus: Enchantment Script An Enchantment is a collection of one or more Magic Effects. Editor Dialog: File:Enchantment Editor.png - ID: The editor ID which is used by the Creation Kit. - Name: The name as it will appear in-game. Notes: - A magic effect must match in both Casting and Delivery Types, as well has have its "Magic Skill" set to none, in order for it to be listed and added to an enchantment. - A few magic effect types like Value Modifier (maybe all) need the "Recover" checkbox enabled on the magic effect for their effect to actually apply. See Also: - Potion - Effect Item - Magic Category
